answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 163446 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Please give advice. One person making Umrah and after tawaf he removed hair before sa’i unintentionally. He should give dam. Second he is poor financially. Please advise. Question: Please give advice. One person making Umrah and after tawaf he removed hair before sa’i unintentionally. He should give dam. Second he is poor financially. Please advise. Answer ID: 163446 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1296/1115/D=11/1439) Shaving ones head in the state of ihram makes dam compulsory. Hence in the question mentioned above one dam is wajib on the said person. الواجب دم على محرم بالغ ولو ناسيا إن طيب عضواً ....... أو حلق ربع رأسه الخ التنوير مع الدر والرد : 3/572 تا 579 كتاب الحج / باب الجنايات ط: زكريا ديوبند . وتقديم سعيها على الحق واجب غنية المناسك : 255 باب العمرة ط : یادگار شیخ سہارنپور۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
